<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type Component, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Primitive } from '../../primitive';
import { usePopoverContext } from "./use-popover-context";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    as?: string | Component;
    asChild?: boolean;
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"];
  }>(),
  {
    as: "button",
  }
);

const context = usePopoverContext();
const triggerProps = computed(() => ({
  ...(context.value.getTriggerProps?.() ?? {}),
  type: props.asChild ? undefined : "button",
  "data-slot": "popover-trigger",
}));
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    :as="props.as"
    :as-child="props.asChild"
    :class="cn(props.class)"
    v-bind="triggerProps"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { type HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import type { PositioningOptions } from "@zag-js/popper";
import { usePopover } from "./use-popover";
import { PopoverProvider } from "./use-popover-context";

const props = defineProps<{
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  modal?: boolean;
  closeOnInteractOutside?: boolean;
  closeOnEscape?: boolean;
  positioning?: PositioningOptions;
  id?: string;
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"];
}>();

const emit = defineEmits(["update:open", "change"]);

const api = usePopover(props, emit);
PopoverProvider(api);
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>

import { createContext } from "../../hooks/create-context"
import type { usePopover } from "./use-popover"

export type UsePopoverReturn = ReturnType<typeof usePopover>

export const [PopoverProvider, usePopoverContext] = createContext<UsePopoverReturn>({
    id: "popoverContext",
    providerName: "<Popover />",
})
Popover content

<view class="{{className}}">
  <!-- Trigger -->
  <view 
    id="{{api.triggerProps.id}}"
    bindtap="onTriggerTap"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
  >
    <slot name="trigger"></slot>
  </view>

  <!-- Backdrop (if modal) -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open && modal}}"
    class="popover-backdrop"
    bindtap="onBackdropTap"
  ></view>

  <!-- Content -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open}}"
    id="{{api.contentProps.id}}"
    class="popover-content"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
  >
    <view class="popover-arrow" wx:if="{{showArrow}}"></view>
    
    <view class="popover-header" wx:if="{{title}}">
      <text class="popover-title">{{title}}</text>
      <view 
        class="popover-close" 
        bindtap="onCloseTap"
      >×</view>
    </view>

    <view class="popover-body">
      <slot name="content"></slot>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>

<root-portal wx:if="{{visible}}">
  <!-- Transparent overlay for clicking outside (simplified) -->
  <view class="fixed inset-0 z-40" bindtap="hide" catchtouchmove="noop"></view>
  
  <view id="popover-content" class="fixed z-50 {{baseClass}}" style="{{style}}" catchtap="noop">
    <slot></slot>
  </view>
</root-portal>
